name: validate-compatible-err-shape-undistinguished
body: `validate_compatible` returns `Result<(), SeedFallback>` with no availability gate, so the freshness and recovery callers fold every `Err` to "not fresh" and cannot distinguish an unreadable database from a shape mismatch — sufficient because the discard response is the same rebuild. The crate-visibility promotion is also unexercised until those callers land (phase-4 tasks 6 and 8); upgrade by adding a distinct availability arm only if a caller ever needs to tell unreadable from shape-mismatch.
